content:
I found that the multi-agent handler currently ignores `delegate_task` tool uses, so it never runs a sub-agent or returns a result to the delegating provider. The requested branch, `fix/recursive-agent-delegation`, was created from `main`.

I could not complete the implementation: the repository also contains an OpenAI provider, and the invoked Claude API skill requires stopping and asking how to proceed when it finds non-Anthropic provider markers. No source changes or commit have been made.

Should I implement this as a provider-neutral change using the existing provider interfaces, without switching the OpenAI provider to Claude?
